end.summary:
- Named ants and earthworms as animals found in soil; naming other soil animals is still building and needs checking next time.
- Practised that earthworms are not insects; this mix-up remained at the last turn.
- Practised how earthworm tunnels let air and water into soil; this explanation is still to be checked.
- Practised that soil animals help turn dead leaves into rich soil; the belief that earthworms spoil soil remained at the last turn.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming soil animals and discussing how earthworms and other soil animals help the soil. Pihu named ants and earthworms, but continued to mix up earthworms with insects and to think they spoil soil; neither mix-up was corrected by the last turn. At home, look under a leaf or near a plant and sort examples into “insect” and “not an insect,” then talk about how tunnels help air and water enter soil.
